pages.title: Repeat and queue
pages.text: Repeat supports Off, Current Sound and Playlist. Queued requests play once and interrupt a repeating sound. Old Loop settings migrate to Current Sound repeat.

pages.title: Seeking and restart
pages.text: Restart begins the current sound at zero. Stop resets its position. Jump accepts minutes:seconds, e.g. 1:30. Unknown-duration streams cannot seek.

pages.title: Request ordering
pages.text: Play Next inserts a request at the front; Add to Queue appends. Clearing the queue leaves saved playlists intact. Requests run before the saved source resumes.
